 Data Science Intern
 Tombras, a 600+ person, full-service, national advertising agency with a digital mindset, is seeking a Data Science Intern. 

 You’ll be joining one of the top independent agencies in North America. Connecting Data & Creativity for Business Results® is working for our clients and creating a flywheel affect fueling both client and agency growth. You’ll be a part of a highly creative agency that has been recognized by AdAge, Adweek, Communication Arts, Fast Company, Forbes and Fortune. Tombras was recently named 2025 AdAge Agency of the year and 2024 AdAge Independent Agency of the Year. 

 Where you'll be working: Knoxville, TN 

 What to expect as a Data Science Intern at Tombras: 
 Commitment to a 9.5 week, paid internship of $18 an hour starting on 3/2/27 and ending on 5/7/27 with a maximum of 25 hours per week. 

 What you'll be doing: 
 
• Work with the Data Science team to research, report-on and analyze business and media results – competitive analysis, audience analysis, etc. 
• Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis, Time Series Analysis, Geo-Experiments & Causal Inference techniques, Cluster Analysis, Ad-hoc Analysis, and Bayesian Model Creation 
• Conduct and compile research, regarding algorithms and related statistical research, industry trends, and research papers. 
• Create key analyses for internal teams, to be used in internal presentations, decks and client deliverables. 
• Collaborate with multiple members in analytics along with media and strategy to inform business insights and media decisions. 
• Other responsibilities and tasks as assigned. 

 What you bring: 
 
• Education: Senior in Bachelor’s Program, in a Masters/PhD program, or a recent graduate with a major in Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, AI, Data Science, Engineering, Economics or a similar field (a degree is not required) 
• Experience in programming languages (R, Python, Matlab, Stata, SAS, Julia, etc.) 
• Experience in mathematical models and statistical thinking. 
• Experience making decisions, presentation, analyses, and visualizations from data. 
• Strong written and verbal communication and organizational skills. 
• Strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative. 
• You work well as a team player in a flexible, dynamic and fast-paced environment. 

 Why you'll want to work at Tombras: 
 
• Family - It comes first on every list. Tombras has been family-run since day 1. We strive to facilitate a family-oriented environment rooted in supporting one another. 
• Dog-friendly offices 
• A company culture of promotions from within and an atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development. 

 Want more reasons to work at Tombras? Check out the latest  Tombras News  and  Our Values . 

 Tombras is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.  
 Tombras is an E-Verify employer and participates in the E-Verify program. 

 This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice. Job may require traveling overnight, driving long distances as required and sitting for extended periods of time with occasional walking and standing and occasionally lifting or carrying articles weighing less than 10 pounds.

About the role:

 As a full-time Software Development Intern at TQL, you will be an embedded member of an agile scrum team, working closely with software developers and test engineers to build and test real business applications. You will gain hands-on experience with modern engineering practices, participate in daily agile ceremonies and contribute directly to our technology initiatives. 

 What’s in it for you:
 * Paid internship at $22.00/hour 
 * Gain first-hand knowledge and experience within a robust IT department 
 * Grow your professional network and develop your skillset alongside industry experts
 * Access to the latest emerging technologies 
 * Certified Great Place to Work and voted a 2019-2026 Computerworld Best Places to Work in IT

 What you’ll be doing: 
 * Work within automation test frameworks for UI, API, mobile and desktop applications
 * Build and enhance real business software features as part of a cross functional development team
 * Collaborate with test engineers and software developers to validate application functionality
 * Debug, troubleshoot, and propose solutions to improve application quality
 * Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, estimations and other team ceremonies
 * Design and create test strategies, test cases and test scripts that provide full and accurate coverage of user stories and requirements

 What you need: 
 * Current student graduating between December 2027 to May 2028
 * Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or Engineering
 * Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language
 * Experience with or exposure to: SQL Server, .NET, C#; Angular or React; JSON, XML, REST; Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Bitbucket, Jenkins, ServiceNow; GitHub; Azure; Basic SQL scripting
 * Basic SQL knowledge to be able to write and run scripts 
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills

 Where you'll be: 4286 Ivy Pointe Blvd, Cincinnati, OH 45245

 Employment visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position. Applicants requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., F-1 STEM OPT, H-1B, TN, J1 etc.) will not be considered.

Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

Our team is dedicated to delivering end-to-end software support across all of Dandy’s product lines. Our teams collaborate across the company to ensure customers have an amazing experience at every stage: ordering, manufacturing, and support.

We are looking for motivated Software Engineering Interns to join our team. Our engineers have a high level of ownership, and you will have the opportunity to dive into unfamiliar code bases, debug real-world processes, and help launch novel-to-industry products.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Engineering Intern at Dandy, you will:

 - Contribute to building and maintaining core ordering flows used by our end customers every day.

 - Work across any layer of the stack (frontend, backend, infra, data) to help ship end-to-end product experiences.

 - Collaborate with engineers, product managers, operations teams, and CAD designers to support the launch of innovative new products.

 - Dig in and learn the intricacies of the dental restoratives market—you will know more about dentures than you ever imagined!

What We’re Looking For

 - Currently pursuing an MS degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

 - Foundational experience in web development with an eagerness to work in a production TypeScript, React, and GraphQL environment.

 - A high level of autonomy, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to comfortably navigate ambiguity and unfamiliar areas of a codebase.

 - Familiarity with our specific stack (NestJS, TypeORM, Electron) is a bonus, but not required.

 - Candidates must be able to reliably commute to the Dandy office in New York City, 3x days per week.


WHY JOIN DANDY?

 - Work on real-world healthcare problems with an immediate impact on our platform, customers, and manufacturing operations.

 - Gain hands-on, full-stack experience at a fast-growing startup alongside a world-class technical team.

 - Receive dedicated mentorship from experienced engineers who value ownership, speed, and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Be part of a collaborative, NYC-based team where innovation happens daily.



Req ID: J-1285

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers https://www.meetdandy.com/careers/ for more! 

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you consent to Dandy collecting, storing, and processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.meetdandy.com/privacy-policy/ and GDPR regulations. You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests https://www.meetdandy.com/privacy-requests/.
fit_why: Requires current MS enrollment; candidate is a BSc undergrad

About the role:

 This internship is designed for rising seniors who want to apply classroom knowledge to real-world business challenges. You’ll work alongside experienced Product professionals, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop skills that set you apart in the competitive job market.

 What’s in it for you: 
 * Paid internship at $17.00/hour
 * Grow your professional network and develop your skillset alongside industry experts
 * Immersion into TQL’s award-winning culture through meet & greets, team events and more
 * Gain valuable real-world experience at a Certified Great Place to Work with 900+ lifetime workplace award wins

 What you’ll be doing:
 * Find AI opportunities: Shadow brokers, carrier reps and operations teams to spot manual, repetitive steps in the shipment process (quoting, covering loads, tracking updates, prospecting) that AI could automate or speed up
 * Support product discovery: Run user interviews, write problem statements and help turn findings into user stories and requirements for the Product and Engineering teams
 * Analyze data: Use shipment, pricing or tracking data to size an opportunity and define success metrics
 * Own a capstone project: Take one AI use case from idea to recommendation, then present your findings, prototype and business case to Product leaders at the end of the summer

 What you need:
 * Current student graduating between December 2027 to May 2028
 * Pursuing a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Data Science, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management or a related field
 * Strong interest in AI, plus hands-on experience with tools like ChatGPT, Copilot or similar, whether through class, personal projects or past work
 * Comfortable with data, such as Excel or SQL. Python or Power BI is a plus.
 * Curious and problem solver. You like asking "why" and breaking down how a process really works.
 * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical ideas to non-technical people
 * Able to manage your own project and work with others on cross-functional teams
 * Nice to have: coursework or experience in product management, UX research, logistics or supply chain

 Where you'll be: 4289 Ivy Pointe Blvd Cincinnati, OH 45245 

 Employment visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position. Applicants requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., F-1 STEM OPT, H-1B, TN, J1 etc.) will not be considered.
fit_why: Product/discovery and shipment analysis role; not core software engineering

About the role: 

 As a full-time Data Science and Analytics Intern at TQL, you will help identify and resolve business problems with data. You will apply analytical techniques to solve complex business questions.  You will gain experience building scalable reports, visualizations, models and analytics within TQL’s award-winning IT department. 

 What’s in it for you: 
 * Paid internship at $22.00/hour 
 * Gain first-hand knowledge and experience within a robust IT department 
 * Grow your professional network and develop your skillset alongside industry experts
 * Access to the latest emerging technologies 
 * Certified Great Place to Work and voted a 2019-2026 Computerworld Best Places to Work in IT

 What you’ll be doing: 
 * Conduct exploratory data analysis using summary statistics and time series analysis to identify trends and patterns in historical data
 * Develop and maintain data visualizations that effectively communicate insights and support data-driven decision-making
 * Ensure the accuracy and quality of data used in reports and dashboards
 * Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to understand their data needs. Utilizing a data-driven analytic approach, develop a solution to aid in their decision making
 * Provide great customer service to all stakeholders

 What you need: 
 * Current student graduating between December 2027 to May 2028
 * Experience with PowerBI or other data visualization tools like Tableau, Qlik, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Shiny, ggplot2, Anaconda, etc.
 * Coding experience (SQL, R or Python) preferred, but not required
 * Pursuing a degree in Statistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Economics or a related field 
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 * Exceptional aptitude for applied mathematical concepts like Statistics, Linear Regressions and/or Predictive and Descriptive Analytics 

 Where you'll be: 4289 Ivy Pointe Blvd., Cincinnati, Ohio 45245

 Employment visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position. Applicants requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., F-1 STEM OPT, H-1B, TN, J1 etc.) will not be considered.

jd:
Digital Control Incorporated (DCI) is the world’s leading supplier of underground locating and steering products for the horizontal directional drilling (HDD) industry. Since the introduction of this revolutionary technology 30 years ago, Digital Control has been at the forefront of trenchless technologies that enable the efficient installation of underground utilities such as fiber optic, telecom, gas, and water lines world-wide. DCI’s products are valued for their durable design, ease of use and uncompromising commitment to customer service. 
 We have an exciting opportunity on the Engineering team for a full-time Summer 2027 Intern . This internship will be based out of our headquarters in Kent, WA. 
 DCI is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Engineering department. You’ll apply software engineering principles to real-world technical problems in the horizontal directional drilling (HDD) industry, working closely with senior engineering staff to design, prototype, build, and test products used by crews in the field. While this internship is software-focused, you'll work closely with hardware, writing code for embedded systems and getting hands-on with the electrical and mechanical sides of product development. It suits a student who enjoys moving between code, circuits, and assembly, and wants to see their work make a real impact. 
 
 What You’ll Do:  
 
• Design, prototype, build, and test software and hardware for underground construction applications.  
• Develop new technologies and enhance existing products alongside senior engineers  
• Write, review, and maintain software, including embedded and system-level code.   
• Evaluate circuits and support hardware design decisions.  
• Debug software and hardware issues across the full system.   
• Perform hands-on assembly of prototypes and test fixtures.   
• Plan and run system performance tests; analyze results and recommend improvements.   
• Write clear technical documentation for the systems you build  
• Other related duties as assigned.  
• Present project results and recommendations to management

• Junior or Senior undergrad student pursuing a Software Engineering degree, or a related field  
• Engineering fundamentals equivalent to junior-year coursework, including proficiency in one programming language (Python, C/C++, or Bash) and exposure to a second  
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  
• Excellent written and oral communication skills  
• Ability to work well in a team environment  
• Passionate about learning new ideas   
• Minimum overall GPA of 3.0  
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 
• Experience with Linux and/or Raspberry Pi or similar 
• 3D printing design experience with exposure to OnShape, SolidWorks or similar  
• Experience with hardware and electrical engineering design and concepts

• Paid internship - $27 per hour 
• PTO (accrue 6.77 hours per bi-weekly paycheck) 
• Paid holidays plus 1 floating holiday 
• Free convenient parking and commuter benefits 
• Located in a quiet business park near walking trail 
 Why DCI?  
 Work hard, play often... DCI employees are innovative and creative. Our open (forest-like) work environment creates free flowing conversations across all functions. We have gaming days; Lego challenges and ping pong matches to build on our creativity when one hits a roadblock. If that is not enough, our employees bring their four-legged companions (dogs) to work and can take them for a walk around the Green River trail. 
 DCI takes pride in caring a lot about our employees. We believe that employees should not be burdened with benefits expenses, so we provide lucrative health care plans unmatched in most other companies. We also like to eat at DCI and find any excuse to celebrate the most random holidays (Pi Day, Chocolate Ice Cream Day, etc.) We have monthly catered lunches, a fully stocked snack area, sporting tickets, wellness competitions, and most importantly a team of people who will tell you that DCI is the best place they've ever worked. This is evident by our long service team and low turnover. 
 
 We Celebrate Inclusion: 
 DCI is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at DCI is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. DCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.
 It is DCI’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. The Company's EEO policy includes the full & complete support of the Company and all levels of leadership. Because it's just the right thing to do. We hope you think so, too.
fit_why: Embedded/hardware-focused role; his web and LLM stack barely overlaps
